description: Angular component for managing SMS provider settings and notification configurations in the Thingsboard admin UI.

classes.name: SmsProviderComponent
classes.description: Angular component for SMS provider configuration and notification settings management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, fetches current user, builds forms, and loads settings.

methods.name: buildSmsProviderForm
methods.description: Creates the form group for SMS provider configuration.

methods.name: sendTestSms
methods.description: Opens a dialog to send a test SMS.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the SMS provider settings via admin service.

methods.name: confirmForm
methods.description: Returns the form group to confirm for exit guard.

methods.name: buildGeneralServerSettingsForm
methods.description: Creates the form group for notification delivery method configurations.

methods.name: saveNotification
methods.description: Saves notification settings after processing form data.

methods.name: isSysAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has SYS_ADMIN authority.
